name: IT Services & Network Operations
responsibilities: Wi-Fi connectivity, WPA2-Enterprise access points
Wired Ethernet in dorms and study halls
Campus student printing kiosks and quotas
Computer lab workstations and peripherals

name: Classroom AV & Media Support
sla: 15-30 minutes for active lectures, 4 hours general
responsibilities: Lecture hall projectors, screens, and lectern touchscreens
Wireless projection, HDMI/USB-C adapters
Microphones, lecture capture recording systems
Smartboards and digital displays

responsibilities: Water fountains, plumbing, restroom repairs
Classroom furniture, broken desks and seating
Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC)
Building doors, locks, lighting, and physical accessibility

name: Student Information Systems & Identity Management

Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA / Duo Security)
Account lockouts, password resets, campus email access
Student ID card digital badge authorization

name: Academic Affairs & Advising

Academic probation and grade appeal petitions
Degree audit evaluations and major transfer requests
Faculty communication escalations

Financial holds on class registration
Scholarship, grant, and loan disbursement tracking
Emergency installment payment plans
